title.narrative: EU support for vaccine deployment in the Eastern Partnership

description.narrative: Rapid vaccination is key to contain the COVID-19 pandemic and enable socio-economic recovery, as well as contribute to post-pandemic longer-term resilience of health systems. The overall objective of this Action is to reduce the COVID-19 health impacts in the Eastern Partnership countries. This will be achieved through ensuring a rapid and safe deployment of COVID-19 vaccines in the short term, but also strengthening of routine immunisation systems for longer term health resilience.
